_readme: Shared interface strings, in English (en) and Spanish (es); both halves must have the same keys (the build checks). Each page's own copy is in src/_data/pagecopy/<page>.json, with the same en/es shape. Templates read this file as `t` (t.labels.joinZoom) in the page's language. Write the email, date, times and Zoom numbers only as tokens ({email}, {date}, {time}, {startsAlso}, {zoomId}, {passcode}…); the build fills them in from site.json. landing.eyebrow, landing.subline and labels.interpretationValue are also read by scripts/build-brand.mjs for the social cards.
